scope: Task success rate over spur geometry, axis orientation and local occlusion at a canonicalized approach pose, from pre-registered targets. Not a field success rate, not a reachability study, and not outdoor or sensor-calibrated robustness.
aggregation: DuckDB over sql/*.sql; every reported number is produced by those queries

target_register.selection_rule: Measure every connected component of each tree's SPUR mesh; keep those with 0 < max_radius_m <= 0.012; sample 10 per tree with seed '20260923:tree<N>' over the pool ordered by component_first_vertex.
